segments.he: דע שעל חליף טוב וכו' בקנאו את קנאתי וכו' נאמר גם כן בשמיני עצרת הנ"ל:
segments.en: And the essence of its completion is when one merits, during prayer, the hispashtus hagashmiyus [divesting of corporeality], as is explained in Shulchan Oruch, Siman 98 — to cleave oneself at that moment, at minimum, to the light of the Infinite.
